method: tools/measure-hover.cjs: real-time screenshots of Shop tile 2 (Silver sculpture) during a 1.5s hover at 1440x950 in Chrome; each frame aligned to the resting frame by the best vertical shift (undoes the lift), then the remaining change is measured over the tile interior. Spotlight test: cursor moved across the hovered tile, background band compared.

reading.alignedBrighteningShareMax: share of tile pixels >25 levels brighter than rest after undoing the lift — glint/sparkle signature
reading.alignedResidualMeanMax: mean change left after undoing the lift — zoom/rotation/shimmer
reading.spotlightBandChangeOnCursorMove: background change while the cursor moves — cursor spotlight

limits: Frame timing depends on machine load; one browser (Chrome) and one tile measured here. verify.cjs repeats the aligned-frame check on every run with thresholds (<2% brightened, residual <4).
